title: Mohit Vora
intro:
Mohit Vora is running for election to the Campbell Union School District school board to represent Trustee Area 4 in California. Vora is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Vora completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
